title: Mystic Crystal on Chalkboard
description: A large glowing crystal ball rests on a black chalkboard covered in colorful paint marks and writing. A lit candle, brass compass, scattered papers, and lavender sprigs sit around the board against a dark blue textured wall.
prompt: A large glowing crystal ball with floating papers and light patterns rests on a black chalkboard covered in colorful paint marks and writing. A lit candle in a holder, brass compass, scattered papers, and sprigs of lavender sit around the board against a dark blue textured wall in a mysterious magical setting.
